protocol: Fixed 28 pilot + 60 holdout ADE validation images. Positive >=1.5% whole-image semantic GT. A box supports a group if >=10% of its known pixels have the group label; image hit additionally covers >=20% of group GT. This is coarse semantic-supported box recall, NOT instance AP. No tuning or failure removal. Latency PC batch=1, warm, including preprocessing/postprocessing.

yoloe26n.variant: official segmentation weights loaded into official detection-only architecture

evidence_level: Level 2 PC real model, public semantic annotation proxy; NOT Android acceptance

sources.model_license: Ultralytics AGPL-3.0 / Enterprise; no enterprise license acquired

limitations: Single PC pass, no speed guarantee on phone; no CPU affinity or paired timing repetition.
Frozen existing ADE sample; semantic connected areas are not instance bounding-box GT. No AP claimed.
No monitor-positive image in this subset. Person and vehicle retention not evaluated.
Any training overlap for YOLOE not independently audited; not a novel external benchmark.
Zero-GT detections flag annotation mismatch for review, not adjudicated false positives.
Prototype labels/parameters never changed after looking at model results. First attempt failed due missing wcwidth; fixed dependency only.
The 60 held-out images are the prior SegFormer holdout; no YOLOE prompt tuning on either subset.
